scope: Bounded independent semantic/form review of the exact accepted-key-text correction from frozen B02 v1 to v2. Reuses matching v1 review of unchanged whole-object facts, alternatives, diagnostics, Reason, Details and item identity; not full N07 cross-unit, source, producer, consumer, admission, runtime, native, Premium or full-BIZQ acceptance.

correctionEvidence.changedFields: accepted option text only for 18 items; IDs, options, facts, feedback and explanations preserved

authorNotesSnapshot.role: author hypotheses only; not acceptance evidence

correctionAssessment: The 18 revised accepted options are concise statements of the same scenario-specific consistency boundary. None relies on an unstated discriminator: independent or lag-tolerant behavior remains visible in the unchanged prompt/constraints and explanation. The previous uniquely-longest form cue is resolved; no key is uniquely longest by raw character count. Nine keys are now uniquely shortest, but that is not a reliable answer cue across the set because the corrected keys are not uniformly identifiable by length and all state a complete boundary. No equal-length/count threshold is applied. Existing alternatives remain unchanged and were checked as plausible scenario-specific competitors; no distractor was padded or removed. The before/current accepted option ID and question ID remain justified by the same aggregate-boundary decision and accepted meaning.
limitations: Reuses B02 v1 semantic/identity review only for fields verified unchanged; no whole-N07 cross-unit comparison is claimed.
No source, producer, consumer, admission, runtime, native, Premium or full-BIZQ-01 acceptance is claimed.
